turns.user: Namaste, I need help with digestion
turns.ai: It looks like your digestive fire (Agni) is weakened with a Vata‑Pitta imbalance, known as Vataja Ama causing poor digestion. Warm ginger decoction with a pinch of black pepper, a daily dose of Triphala powder, and a gentle abdominal massage with Mahanarayan Taila can help kindle Agni and clear the accumulated ama. Eat warm, cooked meals such as kichadi, steamed vegetables and a spoonful of ghee, and avoid cold raw salads, fried snacks, caffeine and alcohol. Keep a regular routine, sip warm water throughout the day and sleep early to support the digestive fire.
